name: flowerflow-tests
description: Test tools for FlowerFlow. The site itself only depends on flower.com/package.json.

scripts.integration: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('coverage', { recursive: true })" && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-flowerflow --config ../flower.com/firebase.json "node --test --test-concurrency=1 --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=../flower.com/** --test-coverage-exclude=../flower.com/node_modules/** --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info integration/*.test.js"
